svg.title: CNC Plasma quick cut flow chart
svg.desc: Read columns A to D, top to bottom. Trained authorised teachers only. Complete setup record first. Any failed check means stop. The website has an accessible text equivalent.
svg.text: CNC PLASMA
QUICK CUT FLOW CHART
A3 LANDSCAPE | TRAINED TEACHER REFERENCE
Read down each column, then move to the next.
Each numbered box links to the full operating guide.
START GATE - STEP 01 MUST ALREADY BE COMPLETE

Trained, authorised teacher; supplier-checked installation and completed setup record beside the screen. This chart recalls taught steps. It does not supply unverified recipe values, switch locations or permission to
operate.
Already have a checked TAP? Skip A only when its file revision, material and recorded CAM setup are confirmed.
A PREPARE THE FILE
Computer only | USB DXF to TAP

a.text: 02 Open and size-check the DXF
SheetCam: File > Import drawing
Select USB > your DXF > Open. Choose Metric +
bottom-left drawing position > OK. Measure: square
100 x 100 mm; centre 50,50 mm; hole diameter
matches drawing.
03 Create and preview the cut paths
Operations > jet-cutting icon
Outside Offset; correct Layer and recorded Tool,
Path rules and lead-ins > OK. Show tool paths,
starts and rapids. Run simulation: hole first, square
last; leads in waste; no missing or extra cuts.
04 Save the machine file
File > Save job as; Run post processor
Use the supplier-confirmed post-processor. Save the
checked revision as .tap. Copy that TAP from USB
into the recorded SureControl folder. Keep DXF and
editable job separately.

svg.text: Continue at B (top of next column) >
B PREPARE THE MACHINE
Authorised teacher | real equipment

a.text: 05 Secure the area
Students out | guards + extraction
Dry, clear area; flammables removed. Check guards,
slag drawer, screens, curtains and interlocks.
Confirm screened operator position. Keep
equipment isolated for access/loading.
06 Match sheet, torch and power
Use the completed machine setup record
Support sheet; check work-return clamp + CPC,
consumables, air and water if fitted. Follow recorded
power-on order; extraction running. Set PHYSICAL
source current to match the job recipe.
07 Connect SureControl
Connect > Offline > Online
Open SureControl: Disconnected. Click Connect;
expect Offline (button becomes Reset). With travel
clear, select Online. Fresh start: expect Not
Referenced.
08 Reference the axes
Reference > recorded axes > Start > OK
Watch from the designated position. Wait for normal
completion before OK. This moves the machine; it
does not set the part origin.

svg.text: Continue at C (top of next column) >
C LOAD, CHECK, POSITION
Authorised teacher | people clear

a.text: 09 Load the checked job
Load > folder > correct .tap > OK
Import DXF stays unticked for this TAP route. Check
filename/revision, square, hole and orientation. A
new job normally shows Set Origin.
10 Verify Touch sensing
Recorded slow jog + sensor test
For the confirmed contact test: Page Down gently to
contact; RELEASE. Touch INDICATOR turns green.
Page Up to recorded clearance; indication clears.
No Shift/full-speed jog.
11 Torch test ONLY if recorded
Torch On/Off icon = REAL FIRING
If required, use recorded test position, protection
and duration; extraction/screens active. Click to fire,
click again to stop; verify arc out. If explicitly not
required, continue. Blank test record: STOP.
12 Position and assign part zero
Arrow keys to jog > Set Origin
Use recorded clearance/speed. Allow room for
square, kerf, leads and travel. Release keys; click
Set Origin. Check zero/crosshair. Origin is a MOVE
command; do not confuse the two.

svg.text: Continue at D (top of next column) >
D DRY RUN, CUT, FINISH
Authorised teacher | final decision

a.text: 13 Dry run with NO arc
Simul ON > Start from beginning
Real machine movement. Observe full route: hole
first, square last; all travel fits and clears
obstructions. No firing. Wait for Idle. Keep Simul ON
until ready to cut.

svg.text: ALL DRY-RUN CHECKS PASS?
YES: continue down. NO: STOP below.

a.text: 14 Final check, then REAL CUT
Cut Parameters > check recipe > OK
Match file/origin, sheet, consumables and
PHYSICAL current. Confirm CAM/controller settings
agree. Read the option strip below. Extraction
running; access secured; teacher behind
screens/curtains. Start from beginning.
15 Finish and isolate before access
Idle > recorded shutdown + isolation
Wait for arc out and motion stopped. Allow recorded
cooling/post-flow/extraction timing; verify electrical
isolation before student entry. Retrieve with
specified tools/PPE when safe; measure and record
result.

svg.text: BEFORE REAL CUT - READ EACH OPTION
Touch ON | Laser OFF | Online ON | Simul OFF | THC = recorded state | Kerf = recorded state (no double compensation)
ANY FAILED CHECK / WRONG STATE / UNSAFE ACCESS: STOP
Do not cut. During danger, use the taught emergency stop. Resolve faults and repeat affected checks/dry run. Stop or Offline is not electrical isolation.
Source: supplied SureControl V2.1 and CNC plasma equipment policy; detailed guide checked 8 Sep 2026. Current school procedure takes precedence.
Full guide: stevencowell.github.io/Main-Page/CNC-Plasma/guided-operation.html | Print A3 landscape at 100%. Do not reduce if labels become hard to read.
